title: Semantic log search — health
description: OTel metrics, spans and logs for semanticLogSearch.search(). Success rate excludes unavailable, cancelled and rejected searches.

data_source.query: FROM metrics-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.requests IS NOT NULL | STATS `Searches` = SUM(TO_LONG(metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.requests))

FROM metrics-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.requests IS NOT NULL | EVAL n = TO_LONG(metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.requests) | STATS ok = SUM(CASE(attributes.outcome IN ("success", "empty"), n, 0)), failed = SUM(CASE(attributes.outcome == "failed", n, 0)) | EVAL `Success rate` = ok * 1.0 / (ok + failed) | KEEP `Success rate`

FROM metrics-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.duration IS NOT NULL | STATS `p95 latency` = PERCENTILE(metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.duration, 95) * 1000

FROM metrics-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.requests IS NOT NULL | EVAL n = TO_LONG(metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.requests) | STATS `Unavailable` = SUM(CASE(attributes.outcome == "unavailable", n, 0))

FROM metrics-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.requests IS NOT NULL | STATS searches = SUM(TO_LONG(metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.requests)) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 60, ?_tstart, ?_tend), outcome = attributes.outcome

FROM metrics-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.duration IS NOT NULL | STATS p50 = PERCENTILE(metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.duration, 50) * 1000, p95 = PERCENTILE(metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.duration, 95) * 1000 BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 60, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

FROM metrics-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.phase.duration IS NOT NULL | STATS p95 = PERCENTILE(metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.phase.duration, 95) * 1000 BY phase = attributes.phase | SORT p95 DESC

FROM metrics-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.phase.duration IS NOT NULL | STATS p95 = PERCENTILE(metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.phase.duration, 95) * 1000 BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 60, ?_tstart, ?_tend), phase = attributes.phase

FROM metrics-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.active_requests IS NOT NULL | STATS peak = MAX(TO_LONG(metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.active_requests)) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 60, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

config.title: Failed and unavailable searches by reason and phase

data_source.query: FROM metrics-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.requests IS NOT NULL AND attributes.outcome NOT IN ("success", "empty") | STATS searches = SUM(TO_LONG(metrics.kibana.logs.semantic_search.requests)) BY outcome = attributes.outcome, reason = attributes.reason, phase = attributes.failure_phase | SORT searches DESC

FROM logs-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND attributes.log.logger == "plugins.logsDataAccess" | EVAL message = SUBSTRING(body.text, 0, 160) | STATS occurrences = COUNT(*), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY level = severity_text, message | SORT last_seen DESC | LIMIT 50

FROM traces-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND name == "semantic_log_search.search" AND attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.sampled IS NOT NULL | STATS `Sampled searches` = AVG(CASE(attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.sampled == true, 1.0, 0.0))

FROM traces-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND name == "semantic_log_search.search" AND attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.candidates_capped IS NOT NULL | STATS `Candidates capped` = AVG(CASE(attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.candidates_capped == true, 1.0, 0.0))

FROM traces-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND name == "semantic_log_search.search" AND attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.categorize_row_limit_reached IS NOT NULL | STATS `Categorize row limit hit` = AVG(CASE(attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.categorize_row_limit_reached == true, 1.0, 0.0))

FROM traces-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND name == "semantic_log_search.search" AND attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.candidate_count IS NOT NULL | STATS `p95 rerank candidates` = PERCENTILE(attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.candidate_count, 95)

config.title: Slowest searches (open trace_id in Discover for the phase breakdown)

data_source.query: FROM traces-generic.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND name == "semantic_log_search.search" | EVAL duration_ms = ROUND(duration / 1000000.0, 1) | KEEP @timestamp, duration_ms, attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.outcome, attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.caller, attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.candidate_count, attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.pattern_count, attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.sampled, attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.candidates_capped, attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.rerank_input_characters, trace_id | RENAME attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.outcome AS outcome, attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.caller AS caller, attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.candidate_count AS candidates, attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.pattern_count AS patterns, attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.sampled AS sampled, attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.candidates_capped AS capped, attributes.kibana.logs.semantic_search.rerank_input_characters AS rerank_chars | SORT duration_ms DESC | LIMIT 20
